note: Draft plan of the disjoint quick-test shards of MS05r5 (inputs of manifest.js). A selector is one command: the node runner with --suite=<names> only, or with no option for the whole app. projectionBasis starts with MEASURED (this tree), STALE (measured on an earlier tree, so only an indication) or UNMEASURED (no valid measurement; a ceiling from earlier evidence). No projection is a result: MS05r6b measures every shard, and MS05r5m, MS05b3 and MS05r6a refresh the plan first.

shards.projectionBasis: UNMEASURED: the 16 shared suites in the Generator environment; no per-suite time exists. Ceiling: the whole Generator quick set took 111 to 112 s at the baseline (report 2.1), shared suites included, plus 40 s for the v3 additions (harness +12 tests, MS01 to MS05a tests)
